0022600125.text: Both teams are unbeaten at 2-0, with the Rockets (1-0 at home) first in the Southwest and third in the West, while the Hawks are first in the Southeast and first in the East. Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain), and Steven Adams (ankle), and Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating Atlanta 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
